facts.fact: A circular of the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries requires the bodies under its tutelage to integrate E-Houwiya, the standard for authenticating users, into their platforms and online services by 15 November 2026, building on a pilot that put authorisations for the public hydraulic domain through E-Houwiya.
